newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sees lower sunflower output in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sees lower sunflower output in 1997.

text.p: Bulgaria's agriculture ministry said on Thursday 375,000 hectares would be planted with sunflowers in 1997 and forecast an output of 450,000 tonnes, compared to 529,876 tonnes in 1996.

A ministry plan set the sunflower area at 375,000 ha, down from last year's 499,842. But Georgi Spiridonov, chief of the ministry's planting department, told Reuters even these figures were unrealistic.
"It is not sure that the target will be reached as purchasing prices are low and sunflower growers don't have any incentives," he said.
He said bad weather and scarce funds had hindered the sector last year. --Sofia Newsroom +359-2-84561
